marta: Quick design check — I sketched an alternative for the run log + action drawer. Main idea: dock a narrow action drawer to the right of the run log so you can keep the schema peek visible while taking actions. Thoughts? jamal: Love the idea of keeping schema visible. Two quick questions: 1) does drawer overlap the token preview? 2) keyboard focus order? marta: Drawer would be resizable but default 320px, and it should not overlap the token preview — preview stays left. For keyboard: tab should go into the run list -> open entry -> move into drawer. We can add `aria-hidden` toggles. cheng: Sketch looks clean. Accessibility nits: ensure the drawer has `role=\"dialog\"` and a visible close button for screen readers. Also color contrast for action badges (green/amber/red) needs checking. lina: Microcopy tweak: instead of \"Run actions\" header, use \"Actions for this run\" — clearer for screen readers. Also add a short tooltip for the \"re-run\" icon explaining how batching interacts with it. jamal: Interaction question — if someone selects multiple runs (shift + click), should drawer show aggregated actions or be disabled? I think aggregated (bulk re-run, export prompts). marta: Good call. Bulk mode makes sense but we should grey out any action that isn’t applicable. Maybe show a small banner: \"Bulk actions mode\". cheng: For the schema peek: can we make a small folded state to reduce noise? A one-line summary with a chevron to expand. Also keyboard shortcut `k` to toggle. lina: UX concern: when schema preview is collapsed, function signatures should still show so devs know what tools were called. Minimal pill chips with truncated arg names. marta: Agree. Pill chips + hover expands to full param list. Also thinking about adding a copy button for the schema JSON. ops-bot: deploy-bot: New design branch `runlog-action-drawer` created. CI checks queued. :robot_face: jamal: Accessibility prototype idea — show live focus outlines in purple when keyboard navigation is on (like Focus Visible). It helps QA spot missing focus states. cheng: Example aria snippet we can include in the spec: ```
Actions for the selected run
``` cheng: Also flag: ensure `aria-live` updates for long-running actions (re-run progress) so screen readers announce status. lina: Copy suggestion for the re-run confirmation modal: \"This will re-run the selected run(s) using the same model and prompt. Costs may apply.\" Clear and explicit. marta: Thanks — I'll update the Figma with the drawer states (single run, bulk run, and error state). Next steps: Jamal, can you prototype keyboard flow? Cheng, can you run contrast checks and produce the aria snippet in the spec? Lina, can you write the modal copy + tooltip lines? jamal: On it. Will try a keyboard-first prototype by EOD tomorrow. cheng: Will run contrast tests and paste results into the PR. lina: I'll draft copy and do a quick content pass on the existing run history strings to align tone. marta: Awesome. If CI passes we can merge the branch behind a feature flag and test with a few power users. :thumbsup:
